    New for 2026–27

    DLC prep

    DECA released the instructional areas for this year's district role-plays. Pick your event to see every PI that has shown up in past district role-plays from that same event and area, ranked by how often, with a full judge-ready write-up for each and a concept page for every area.

    Four ways to prep

    Every guide is split the same way, so you always know where to look.

    StudyCore concepts with videos, live market data, and real-world case studies.
    TestEvery past exam, newest first, plus formula sheets and vocabulary.
    Role-playA step-by-step strategy, judge-ready PI responses, past role-plays, formula sheets, and a prep clock.
    DLCThis year's district areas: the PIs past district role-plays used, a write-up for each, and one concept per area.

    Before a guide goes up

    Every guide is checked against this list. If one item fails, it doesn't ship.

    • Complete role-play and exam archive, in true reverse chronological order
    • Every link opens the document itself, never a landing page
    • 2026–27 rubric changes explained for every event
    • One video for each core concept
    • 20 judge-ready PI responses
    • Rendered to PDF and reviewed page by page
